run_l2reg_sweep: run the l2reg_sweep function to generate hypermodel configs over l2 regularization parameters
run_index_sweep: run the index_sweep function to generate hypermodel configs over index dimension parameters
run_boot_sweep: run the boot_sweep function to generate hypermodel configs over bootstrap distribution parameters
run_prior_sweep: run the prior_sweep function to generate hypermodel configs over prior function parameters
run_combined_sweep: run the combined_sweep function to generate a combined set of hypermodel configs from all sweeps
